run_metadata.coverage_summary: SEVERELY DEGRADED RUN — FOURTH CONSECUTIVE egress outage (same condition as 2026-10-21, 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23). The execution environment's network policy blocks ALL outbound HTTPS: WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host (verified this run against www.tenders.gov.au AND example.com), and a direct proxy CONNECT answers 403 (policy denial; per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 CONNECT must be reported, not routed around). So NO tender portal, detail page or specification document could be opened on any tier. The only working external channel is WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure), which returns titles/URLs/model-summarised snippets dominated by stale cached data and cannot read JavaScript-rendered live portals (buy.nsw, tenders.vic, QTenders, NT QTOL), follow pagination, or open attachments. Tier 1 (AusTender + all state/territory portals), Tier 2 (VendorPanel public tenders, councils, GBE water/energy, universities) and Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP/Rio/Fortescue major-buyer portals) were all ATTEMPTED via WebSearch only (8 queries across tiers). WebSearch DID surface several plausible new ACT/VIC/NSW/Federal candidate opportunities this run (ACT RFT PICE0014832 Thermal Assisted Aerial Control; ACT PIJC0012268 Interpreting & Translating Services; Ports Victoria T421509 Station Pier fender upgrade; Goulburn Valley Water Shepparton WTP disinfection upgrade; NSW New Electric Bus Program Technical Advisor Services; Federal ANNPSR commercial pressurised-water-reactor technical support) — but NONE could be opened or independently corroborated on its buyer-originated portal (a targeted confirmation search for the two ACT tender IDs returned zero matching results, and GVW/Ports hits came only via a paid aggregator). Per the fidelity rule these unverified WebSearch-only candidates are recorded in gaps for verification once egress is restored, NOT captured as confirmed tenders. The 5 currently-open opportunities previously captured on 2026-10-16..20 (when WebFetch worked) are carried forward at headline level because their published closing dates (2026-11-12 .. 2026-12-11) remain within their open windows today (2026-10-24). TWO genuinely new buyer-originated sources were identified this run: the Goulburn Valley Water tender channel (surfaced via aggregator discovery signal, then recorded as the buyer's own source) and the Commonwealth Supplier Portal (a new federal procurement system rolling out through 2026, confirmed via finance.gov.au / digital.nsw).
gaps: CRITICAL TOOLING OUTAGE (4th consecutive run; unchanged from 2026-10-21/22/23): outbound HTTPS is blocked by the environment's network policy. WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every host; a direct proxy CONNECT answers 403. Verified this run via WebFetch against both www.tenders.gov.au and example.com (both ENOTFOUND) and via curl to the proxy (403 CONNECT tunnel failed). Per the proxy README a 403 CONNECT is a policy denial that must be reported, not routed around. No live tender portal, detail page or document could be opened.

Because detail pages were unreachable, NO deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria / document / contact extraction was possible this run. All 5 tenders are headline-level only (counted in entries_pending_detail); their fields derive from prior runs (2026-10-16..20) and must be re-verified on the live portals once egress is restored.

UNCONFIRMED CANDIDATE OPPORTUNITIES surfaced via WebSearch this run but NOT captured as tenders (could not be opened or corroborated on their buyer portals; recorded here so an egress-restored run can verify them): (1) ACT RFT PICE0014832 'Thermal Assisted Aerial Control', City & Environment Directorate, reportedly released 2026-10-19, closing ~2026-11-24 — a targeted confirmation search for this ID returned ZERO matching results, so the ID/dates are unverified and may be search-index artefacts; (2) ACT PIJC0012268 'Interpreting and Translating Services', Justice & Community Safety Directorate, reportedly released 2026-10-20, closing ~2026-11-17 — likewise not independently corroborated; (3) Ports Victoria T421509 'Station Pier fender upgrade' (distinct from the carried-forward T421508 pile-rehab tender), reportedly closing ~2026-11-30 — buyer-originated (Buying for Victoria) but unopened; (4) Goulburn Valley Water 'Design & Construction of Disinfection Upgrades at Shepparton WTP' (aggregator tender id 611046, marked 'Current') — confirmable ONLY via a paid aggregator (discovery signal), buyer portal unreadable, closing date unverified; (5) NSW 'New Electric Bus Program — Technical Advisor Services', reportedly closing 2026-11-04 — no tender id captured, buy.nsw unreadable; (6) Federal — Australian Naval Nuclear Power Safety Regulator 'Commercial Pressurised Water Reactor Technical Support Services', reportedly closing 2026-11-10 — surfaced only via a paid aggregator with no publish date, AusTender unreadable. None invented; all require live-portal verification.

WebSearch index is stale: queries for Oct/Nov-2026 closings on every Tier 1 portal returned predominantly mid-2026 (closed) listings or platform/landing/help pages. Exhaustive Tier 1 coverage was NOT achieved this run.

Tier 1 state portals (buy.nsw, tenders.vic, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) are JavaScript-rendered; WebSearch snippets showed only cached shells (and in buy.nsw's case a demo.buy.nsw.gov.au sandbox with sample data), so current open-tender lists were not visible.

None of the 5 carried-forward tenders could be independently re-confirmed on their live portals this run (egress blocked). They are carried forward solely on the basis of their previously-captured, still-open published closing dates (GPSnet EOI DOT46088 closes 2026-11-20; WorkCover occupational rehab FOL26-3030 2026-11-30; Latrobe Regional Health payroll RFQ2262 2026-11-18; ACT Healthy Waterways PICE0014602 2026-11-12; Ports Victoria Station Pier T421508 2026-12-11).

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside/Santos, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas and NFP/health supplier portals are registration/login-gated and/or not readable via WebSearch; no publicly-visible corporate RFx could be confirmed. No corporate opportunities were invented. These portals remain recorded in prior discovered_sources.
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs) remain out of scope and were not fabricated.
recommended_seed_additions: Goulburn Valley Water (Victorian regional water corporation / GBE) tender channel — gvwater.vic.gov.au; enquiries tenders.contracts@gvwater.vic.gov.au. Worth adding to the permanent known-source list if not already present; verify its posting platform on the live portal once egress is restored.

Commonwealth Supplier Portal (finance.gov.au) — new federal procurement system rolling out through 2026 (MAS Panel and People Panel first; open to all businesses from July 2026), launched alongside the updated Commonwealth Procurement Rules. A supplier-registration/discovery database rather than an opportunity feed, but a material new Commonwealth channel to monitor.

OPERATIONAL (not a tender source): This routine has now been unable to reach any live portal for FOUR consecutive runs (2026-10-21/22/23/24). The environment network policy is denying all outbound CONNECTs (403) and WebFetch DNS. The routine cannot perform its core job (open buyer portals and extract deliverables) until the environment is reconfigured with outbound HTTPS access to the tender-portal hosts (or an allow-list added). Human action required: review the environment's network policy at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web.

Buyer-originated source. Marked new this run; if already present in the known 461-source set, treat as a confidence/coverage confirmation. The buyer's exact posting platform (own site vs. a third-party e-sourcing tool) could not be confirmed because the live portal was unreachable (egress blocked) — verify on restoration.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced via WebSearch (finance.gov.au 'Commonwealth Procurement Rules are changing' and digital.nsw coverage) while searching for new/changed government procurement platforms. A publicly-searchable database of potential Commonwealth suppliers launched alongside the updated Commonwealth Procurement Rules; initial rollout to the MAS Panel and People Panel, incrementally extended, open to all businesses from July 2026.
discovered_sources.notes: New federal procurement system rolling out through 2026. It is primarily a supplier-registration/discovery database rather than an opportunity feed (AusTender remains the opportunity publication channel), but it is a material new Commonwealth channel to monitor. URL is the canonical Finance landing area; exact live URL to be confirmed once egress is restored.
